witness.branch: Curbside parking near a railroad rail.
witness.quote: Within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad.
witness.reason: Curbside parking is compatible with additional nearby railroad geometry, though the curb alone supplies no rail evidence.
required_context: Add nearby railroad rails with carrier provenance and retain nearest-rail and vehicle geometry.
Construct curb geometry, traffic direction, parking approach, destination and vehicle and load extent.
Do not infer bus loading, safety-zone relationships, double parking or grade.
Locate the parking destination near the rail and record activity and exception circumstances.
Realize curb geometry, parking route and target, vehicle and load dimensions and traffic direction.
Record actual activities and all claimed exception circumstances; no crossing or train presence is required.
Retain nearest-rail and vehicle geometry against the express 50-foot quantity without selecting a statutory measurement convention.
Supply rail geometry and evidence of a carrier of persons or property on stationary rails other than streetcars.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver can be the person parking a qualifying motor vehicle.
